id.description: Unique identifier for the scheduled callback.

customerName.description: Name of the customer requesting the callback.

callbackNumber.description: Phone number provided for the callback.

timezone.description: Timezone in which the callback is scheduled.

scheduleDate.description: Date for the callback in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).

startTime.description: Scheduled start time in ISO 8601 format (HH:mm:ss), local to the specified timezone.

endTime.description: Scheduled end time in ISO 8601 format (HH:mm:ss), local to the specified timezone.

queueId.description: Identifier for the queue to route the callback request.

callbackReason.description: Reason provided for the callback request.

callbackOrigin.description: Origin of the callback request, such as 'livecall' or 'api'.

createdTimestamp.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the callback was created.

lastUpdatedTimestamp.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the callback was last updated.

assigneeAgent.description: The unique identifier of the agent assigned to handle the callback.

assignedTime.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the assigneeAgent was last updated.
